From an idea to a shoot.

  1. Share your idea

    Tell me what you have in mind, your preferred location and dates, and how you plan to use the photographs.

  2. Agree on the details

    We’ll discuss the scope and quote, including the shoot, image delivery and usage, before making plans.

  3. Make the photographs

    With the brief in place, we can focus on the people, the setting and the moments worth photographing.

What goes into a quote?

The location and travel involved, time on the shoot, the photographs you need and their intended use. Include what you know in your inquiry—we can work through the rest together.

Delivery timing and usage are agreed for your project before the shoot.
